Definition: from G1921; recognition, i.e. (by implication) full discernment, acknowledgement:--(ac-)knowledge(-ing, - ment).
BiblicalUsage: Epignosis is full knowledge, recognition, acknowledgement — the knowledge that changes a person. By the law is the knowledge of sin; Paul prays for the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of Him; he prays the Colossians be filled with the knowledge of His will; and grace and peace are multiplied through the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord.
TheologicalSignificance: Grace multiplies exactly as the knowledge of God grows, and that knowledge is acquaintance, not information. I hold that to know God is to be changed by Him, and Paul's prayers for full knowledge are prayers I should pray daily.
